sample_items.name: Kit 2.44kWp - Panel + Growatt
sample_items.description:
Complete 2.44kWp solar energy kit for grid-tie residential or commercial installation.

**Components Included:**
- Solar Panels: Unknown
- Inverter: Growatt 2.0kW

**Technical Specifications:**
- System Power: 2.44kWp
- Configuration: Grid-tie photovoltaic system
- Estimated Energy Generation: ~329kWh/month (average)

**Pricing:**
